description: This file defines the EmployeeReportData class within the OrangeHRM system. It implements report data processing for employee timesheets, including normalization of timesheet items and meta information such as total durations, employee info, and counts. It utilizes multiple traits and interacts with services and DAOs to gather and format report data for employee time reports.

classes.name: EmployeeReportData
classes.description: Implements report data handling for employee timesheet reports, including normalization of timesheet entries and meta information such as total hours, employee data, and record counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report data with search filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes timesheet data for reporting, formatting project, activity, and duration info.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs meta data, including total hours, employee info, and counts for the report.
